column3: power plan rows: run; if the query changed meanwhile, toast "Power plan changed" (detail: title) and stop; else refresh plans for the submitted query, re-select the same row if the query is still the same, toast "Power plan changed"; a refresh error -> toast "Power plan changed" / "Could not refresh the list: {error}". Clipboard rows: run only. Window rows and all others: run, THEN hide_palette (sequential, never parallel: foreground rights). Then push history (id, historyTitle); for `action::` rows call accept_intent(query (untrimmed), id without "action::"), not awaited; for clipboard rows toast "Copied to clipboard" (detail: toastDetail or title). Any error: power plan -> "Power plan not changed" / error; else "Couldn’t open item" / title
column5: `PaletteState::run_item(item, cx) -> Task<()>` with exactly this order: `execute(item.actions.run)`; `backend.hide_palette(false)` after it for non-clipboard, non-power-plan rows; `app.push_history`; `backend.accept_intent(query_untrimmed, action_id)` fire-and-forget; toasts with the same texts (note the typographic apostrophe in "Couldn’t open item"). The judge cannot observe this sequence (golden-scenarios records closures only); the Step 6 UI scenario list must cover it.
